# scripts/Combat/Fire.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Combat/Fire.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Flame Area3D: ignites flung/already burning guards, lights barrels, and
scorches damage receivers at most once per 0.5 s across the whole area.
Optional fuel burns down to embers; feed() restores fuel and briefly flares.

Base: `Area3D`. Registered class: `none`.
